method: plane (unrolled Schulze ring) shear cell: pre-shear at 200 Pa, shear to failure at 50/100/150 Pa
notes: Real-size salt, E = 2e5 Pa, so normal stresses are kept at 50-200 Pa (overlaps < ~3 % of d); this is the stress range of a few mm to cm of powder head, i.e. the doser's, far below FT4/Schulze test stresses (kPa). Gravity off during shearing. ffc from Mohr circles on a straight yield locus through the three peak points.
